function: Computation offloading decision (task computed on the LEO satellite edge server or at the cloud) learned by DRL; bandwidth split solved by Lagrange multipliers, not learned (p. 8).
notes: Exclude, above_phy (p. 8). The learning acts on task offloading / edge computing decisions. p. 1: "we present a deep reinforcement learning-based computation offloading decision algorithm". p. 8: "The DNN takes the satellite network channel gain ht and computation workload Z t as inputs" and its output is quantized into "K candidate binary computation offloading location decision vectors"; then "DRLO employs channel bandwidth allocation algorithm based on the Lagrange multiplier method to generate τ" (Algorithm 2, binary search, p. 10). So the only learned decision is the offloading location (satellite vs cloud); the bandwidth allocation, the only resource decision on the satellite link, is classical, so no physical-layer decision is learned jointly with the offloading. no_learning was not used because the method itself is learned (DRL); above_phy names task offloading explicitly. Title and DOI on p. 1 match the record.
